title: Globe, weather and news
description: Home pin, admin managed pins, and the weather panel of the globe page. Home is taken from, in order: latitude and longitude here, the address here (looked up once and cached), or, if both are empty and automatic location is on, found automatically from nearby Wi-Fi (needs the Geolocation API on the Google key) or else your internet connection (city level). Weather and air quality come from Google (Weather API and Air Quality API on SECRET_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY, kept on the Pi). Pins added from the touchscreen are kept separately on the mirror and can be removed there. The 3D Earth's browser key (GOOGLE_MAPS_BROWSER_KEY) is set in config.env only.

autoLocate.title: Find home automatically when no address or coordinates are set

weatherRefreshMin.title: Weather refresh (minutes). Each refresh is 3 Weather API calls; 30 or more stays inside Google's free 10,000 a month

autoRotate.title: Slowly rotate the simple globe (Google 3D Earth does not rotate)

maxFps.title: Simple globe: max frames per second
